decisions.reason: The answer-framework placement change belongs to the separate answer-layer Requirement and does not alter the rules for curating the existing question set.
The AI chapter is a basic non-question-and-answer chapter, so restructuring interview-answer layers does not change its topic, format, coverage, or length.
The source changes the shared structure of developed answers but does not change this chapter's topic, question-and-answer format, or question-count policy.
Integrating frameworks into the how-to-frame layer does not alter the requirement to weave country and market differences throughout the book.
This is a basic non-question-and-answer chapter, and the answer-layer modification does not alter its leadership focus, format, or word limit.
The shared answer-layer rule is represented by the source Requirement and does not change this chapter's subject, format, or flexible question-count guidance.
The writing test was already completed and verified; the later contract-scope refinement does not modify that completed pre-project deliverable.
The answer-framework placement decision does not alter the remote and hybrid chapter's subject, question-and-answer format, or question-count policy.
The answer-layer modification has no necessary effect on the project's duration target, flexibility, or milestone order.
The framework-placement change does not alter the existing 50,000-word cap or the recorded first-edition and available-word estimates.
